about_the_game: Razsoul is an action-packed, side-scrolling platformer where players control a dynamic character navigating through challenging levels filled with enemies, power-ups, and epic boss battles. Set against a vibrant, scrolling backdrop, the game offers multiple difficulty modes—Easy, Medium, Hard, and Extreme—each adjusting enemy speed, projectile intensity, and player lives (capped at 5 before cycle 32 and 10 after). Players can jump, double jump, fly with power-ups, shoot fireballs, and even unlock faster fireballs by defeating all bosses by cycle 32. The game features a save/load system, a high score tracker, and a pause menu with options to save, load, or return to the main menu. With increasing levels and boss cycles, Razsoul combines strategic combat with fluid movement, enhanced by gamepad and keyboard controls, making it a thrilling test of skill and endurance. short_description: Razsoul: a side-scrolling action platformer with heroic combat. Players jump, double jump, fly, shoot fireballs, dodge projectiles, navigate obstacles, and battle bosses. Its appeal lies in fast-paced gameplay, strategic power-ups, and escalating difficulty, testing reflexes and skill.
